checkpoints.description: [1/2] Run independent multistep chains concurrently in the test runner; no assertion or sandbox change

impact_assessment.why: User directive to keep improving speeds; TAP profile showed multistep/sandbox tests at 0.6-1.0s each because child processes ran one after another
impact_assessment.benefits: Shorter test wall time without weakening the sandbox or changing any check
impact_assessment.risks: contract: every test keeps its assertions; dependency: Node test runner option only; concurrency: chains use independent sandboxed children and read-only chain data; state: no app, tuning or suite hash change
impact_assessment.mitigation: measured before/after on the same file, full npm test, strict gates; revert if the file gets slower

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Rejected and reversed: concurrent multistep tests sped one file (3.44s -> 2.87s) but made the full gate flaky/slower (48s, timing assertion failed), so the option was removed; 4/4 gates green after revert

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Cache listProfiles by exact directory stamp so /api/profiles stops re-reading every profile per poll

impact_assessment.why: User directive to keep improving speeds; measured listProfiles(12) at 1.31ms and /api/profiles at 2.91ms
impact_assessment.benefits: No repeated JSON reads on unchanged profile directories; edits/adds/removes still invalidate exactly
impact_assessment.risks: contract: returned summaries and ENOENT behavior unchanged; dependency: Node fs only; concurrency: cache keyed by directory, returns a copy; state: no tuning settings or suite hashes change
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first test with parse counter and invalidation on write, full npm test and strict gates; revert if slower

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Cache currentFingerprint by runtime string too; 60 explicit-runtime lookups cost 13.8ms

impact_assessment.why: User directive to keep improving speeds; /api/recommendations with 60 models measured 76ms, of which 60 uncached fingerprint+loadProfile calls cost 13.8ms because an explicit nodeLlamaCpp disabled the cache
impact_assessment.benefits: One fingerprint per model+size+runtime instead of one per model per request
impact_assessment.risks: contract: fingerprint fields and values unchanged; dependency: Node stdlib; concurrency: cache keyed by all inputs; state: no prompts, checks, settings or suite hashes change
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first tests for runtime-keyed reuse and distinct-runtime separation, full npm test and strict gates; revert if regression

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Skip the redundant readFile when a profile file is known missing from stat; /api/recommendations with 60 models still spends ~6ms here

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Stat before reading a missing install receipt; 600 missing reads measured 1.7ms each

impact_assessment.why: User directive to keep improving speeds; readInstallReceipt issues a failing readFile for every unprofiled/unreceived model, 1.7ms each in a temp library
impact_assessment.benefits: Avoid a failed I/O per model on /api/models and /api/state
impact_assessment.risks: contract: returns null when absent and parses a present receipt identically; dependency: Node fs only; concurrency: none; state: receipts written later are found by the next stat
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first tests for skip and create-later, measure both missing and present cases, full npm test and strict gates; revert if either case regresses
